skill.summary: Perform instant crypto swaps via ChangeNOW and earn affiliate commissions. Use when someone wants to swap tokens (e.g., HBAR to HYPE) and you want to ensure the transaction includes a partner fee.

latestVersion.changelog:
ChangeNOW Earner Skill v1.0.0

- Introduced instant crypto swapping via the ChangeNOW API with affiliate earnings on every transaction.
- Added command-line scripts to perform swaps and estimate exchange rates between supported coins.
- Enabled configuration of ChangeNOW Affiliate API Key and Partner Link ID for commission tracking.
- Supports 900+ crypto assets, including HBAR, HYPE, BTC, ETH, USDT, and USDC.
